attempts.summary: Configured a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster on node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9, MariaDB 10.5 + Galera 26.4 from AppStream). Fixed two real issues found during setup: wrong wsrep_provider path (galera-4 vs galera) and a missing RHEL9 SELinux self-connectto rule for mariadb-backup SST (added a minimal local policy module rather than disabling enforcement). Verified multi-master writes (write via any node visible on the other two), verified availability with node3 stopped (2/3 quorum, write succeeded, visible on remaining node), verified automatic IST resync when node3 rejoined (data present, state Synced). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol for all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id + Synced/cluster_size=3 state, rebooted each node individually (ack returned pre-disconnect via `nohup reboot &`), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and confirmed full cluster health/data after each restart before moving to the next node.
